narr: Lingering low pressure and monsoon moisture fueled scattered thunderstorms over northwest Arizona. A few produced flash flooding and strong winds.
ev: Water and rocks flowed over Highway 66 near mile marker 91.
lsr: Corrects previous rain report from 6 NNE Valentine. Heavy rain carried some rocks onto Route 66 near mile marker 91. Began 135 pm and estimated end time at 210 pm.
